I have farmed this barley plot since my mother taught me. I do not have cash to buy fertilizer from the cooperative — one bag is too much for my small land and I cannot share it this year. I will put manure from my animals on the soil because the land is mine and I must keep it strong. I will sow the barley seed I kept from last harvest, and my children and I will do all the work ourselves.
